entities.name: Friedrich von Hahn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Friedrich II. Graf von Hahn was a German nobleman, a philosopher and astronomer born in Neuhaus, Duchy of Holstein, Holy Roman Empire. He suggested the Doppler effect before Doppler.
